title: philactis nelsonii
intro: Philactis nelsonii, commonly known as Nelson's philactis, is a species of flowering plant in the family Acanthaceae. It is used in traditional medicine due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Philactis nelsonii include wound healing, pain relief, and the treatment of various infections.
